scope.definition: Every discoverable public canonical page counts as one equally weighted item. ChatGPT marketing paths absent from its sitemap are included; private user data and non-page assets are not enumerable public pages.
scope.adaptationRule: KovaGPT implements original Kova-branded equivalents for relevant page families instead of copying third-party text, media, trademarks, or page-for-page editorial archives.

authenticatedTemplates.evidence: Static authenticated template inventory; not verified by this public audit run.
